Case ID: 1080
Case Type: IT Ticket
Date: 2025-03-21
Handled By: IT - Victor Hale
Customer or Requestor: Internal Employee - Noah Patel
Title: MFA enrollment failure for new warehouse supervisor

Issue Description
A newly hired warehouse supervisor could access email with a temporary password but could not complete multi-factor authentication enrollment on the identity platform.

Steps Taken
- Verified the user record had been created correctly from the onboarding feed.
- Checked the identity provider logs and found a mismatched mobile device enrollment attribute from a pre-hire test account.
- Removed the stale enrollment reference and forced a new sign-in session.
- Stayed on a support call with the employee to validate app-based MFA registration and backup code generation.

Resolution
Restored account access, completed MFA enrollment successfully, and confirmed the employee could access email, scheduling, and warehouse dashboards.

Follow-Up
IT updated the onboarding checklist to avoid reusing test enrollment attributes on production identities.

Reference Documents
- Information Security Policy Set
- IT Ticket Resolution Guide v2
